title: Labor-Warranty Upgrade Share Collected with the Replacement System Installations Deposit
content:
# Protection-upgrade share collected with the deposit

## Rule

The protection-upgrade share of a Replacement System Installations contract deposit collects part of any labor-warranty upgrade charged on the contract:

- an upgrade to the Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or the Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus is collected at 100 percent of its charge;
- an upgrade to any other protection tier at 50 percent;
- a contract with no upgrade adds nothing.

The share is rounded to the cent half up. The upgrade and its charge are read from the labor-warranty upgrade charge on the project ledger.

## Cases (hypothetical upgrade charges)

| Upgrade charged | Upgrade charge | Share collected |
|---|---|---|
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | $1849.00 | $1849.00 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | $1499.00 | $1499.00 |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | $899.00 | $449.50 |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | $1287.45 | $643.73 (643.725 rounded half up) |
| None | — | Nothing |
